peoples_entry.name: Painted Men
peoples_entry.note: The Kwéent'qw ('Painted Folk') of the four Tlàaw-k'wáan canyon-and-mesa clans (+3,324 m median): a Pictish-Caledonian and Tlingit-PNW synthesis wearing fulled woad-ochre tartan braccae, twisted bronze/silver torcs, shredded cedar-bark rain-capes, twined slickrock-orchil Chilkat blankets, and red-cedar rod-and-slat clack-armour under strict zoomorphic crest law ('a human face is never drawn', LORE.md §6.5).
